Helper-claimed by Claude while Qwen completes higher-priority work.

DEP-001 ready for review. Added canonical DeploymentPlan contract/schema/planner under services/control-plane/governance/ (deployment_plan.contract.md, deployment_plan.schema.json, deployment_plan.py, test_deployment_plan.py, smoke_test_deployment_plan.py). Updated cron deploy to create DeploymentPlan-backed deployment requests and canonical execution projections with deployment_stage + deployment_plan_id + explicit rollback linkage. Verified with python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/governance -p 'test_*.py', python3 -m unittest discover -s services/control-plane/cron -p 'test_*.py', python3 services/control-plane/governance/smoke_test_deployment_plan.py, and python3 services/control-plane/cron/smoke_test.py. Review focus: stage transition strictness, rollback linkage sufficiency for DEP-002, and whether execution projection fields are enough for EX-001/runtime-manager migration.

Review approved. DeploymentPlan contract, schema, planner, tests, and cron deploy integration all verified. 61 governance tests + 9 cron tests + 17 smoke checks pass. Stage transitions strict, rollback linkage sufficient for DEP-002, execution projection fields sufficient for EX-001/runtime-manager migration.
